# Check if there exists a row where tournament is exactly "vernal ladies" and date contains "sep 2006" and winning score is "203"
condition = (
    df['tournament'].str.lower() == 'vernal ladies'  # exact match for tournament name
) & (
    df['date'].str.contains('sep 2006', case=False, na=False)  # date contains sep 2006
) & (
    df['winning score'] == '203'  # winning score exactly 203
)

# Determine if any row satisfies all conditions
answer = condition.any()
